name: hgi_vm_e0b-fc210e160-tc-f9b
purpose: FILL-9 (fill9-hgi/xv) root cause of FLOORPLAN_MARGIN util 65.7% (788k um2 of macros: 2 x 1024x256 a bank for the 39-bit SECDED words): ECC 0 per owner 10-10 (no new SRAM SECDED) -> 32 macros (394k um2), NC 8 WP 32 WDIRECT 1 (die view hgi_vm4); knob: macro arrangement b = side macro columns at the wq (DMA lane) faces, logic in the centre channel. Bench tb_hgi_vm_core ECC 0 WP 32 exact + MUT 2 bank alias / 3 out of order / 4 wide mask ignored FAIL.

rtl_boundary.waive: 32 SRAM macros + 8 client stations + 32-lane wide port: the daemon yosys probe exceeds 45 s; every client port lands in an ot_hgi_vm_unit station flop and every response leaves a flop (ot_hgi_vm_unit header); tb_hgi_vm_core ECC 0 exact.

bench.name: vm_core_ecc0_exact
bench.cmd: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -P tb_hgi_vm_core.ECC=0 -P tb_hgi_vm_core.WP=32 -P tb_hgi_vm_core.WDIRECT=1 -P tb_hgi_vm_core.MUT=0 -s tb_hgi_vm_core -o {RUN}/bench/e0m0.vvp rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/ot_hgi_vm_core.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/tb_hgi_vm_core.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2.v && vvp {RUN}/bench/e0m0.vvp 2>&1 | tee {RUN}/bench/e0m0.log && grep -q 'PASS HGI-VM' {RUN}/bench/e0m0.log
